svg.text: TECHNICAL CONTRADICTIONS (IMPROVE A, B GETS WORSE)

text.tspan: A tighter sleeve catches 1–2 µm particles
but cuts flow and sleeve life.
Faster spin raises flow and sleeve life but
drives the paper far above its rated
velocity, and adds noise and unbalance.
The water must turn with the basket, but
vanes add a part to remove at every
Counting needs ≈ 20 L on one sleeve,
but silt on the same sleeve shuts the flow
